summary.description: Chromium is a hard, steel-grey metal with high corrosion resistance, used in various industrial applications. Its compounds are often brightly coloured and can vary greatly in toxicity depending on their oxidation state. Chromium (VI) compounds are more toxic than chromium (III).
environmental_impact: Toxic to some species of wildlife, particularly in aquatic environments
Bioaccumulates in some aquatic species (excluding fish), potentially impacting food chains
Toxicity depends on oxidation state, with chromium (VI) being highly toxic and more readily absorbed

top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Due to the widespread industrial use of chromium and its potential environmental toxicity, especially in its hexavalent form, responsible production processes and safe waste management are crucial.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Chromium compounds can contaminate water bodies and bioaccumulate in aquatic organisms, requiring proper water treatment and pollution control to ensure clean water.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Chromium (VI) compounds pose health risks through environmental exposure and occupational hazards, potentially affecting respiratory and other systems when inhaled or ingested.
